cli.finalMessage:
Built the document verification screen with mock data for four documents (ID proof rejected, address proof approved, bank statement under review, photo not uploaded), an overall progress bar with a status chip summary, and per-document upload/replace controls backed by a hidden file input. Selecting a file marks the document "under review" and after a short simulated delay resolves to approved or rejected (with a reason) — all state lives in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`, using Strata token CSS variables (with sensible fallbacks) and logical properties for RTL/dark-mode compatibility.

Note: no `node_modules` were present in this environment, so I couldn't inspect the actual `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons` component APIs — I built the UI with plain semantic elements and inline SVG icons styled via Strata's CSS custom properties instead of importing components I couldn't verify.
